reviews.title: Awful user interface
reviews.text: Quite possibly the worst user interface of the wine cellar management apps I’ve tried

reviews.title: Buy Cellar Tracker
reviews.text: VinoCell is pretty much a data entry app.  Not sophisticated like the Cellar Tracker app where you just scan the barcode or label to add the wine into the app.  Cellar Tracker also has a free version that is pretty sufficient.

reviews.title: Awful non-intuitive app
reviews.text: Total waste of $$$. This app is so time intensive to use, has no auto-recognition of labels, almost no library of wines, and probably very few users - for good reason!
